params.name: C
params.comment: belt centre distance (solved from the 295-5M belt): the clutch/motor axis is at y = -C, straight below the leadscrew

params.name: chamber
params.comment: bracket face to the plate's chamber face (Z_PLATE_IN), 25 to 60 mm

params.name: plate_t
params.comment: plate thickness: 2x bearing_w + 2x (circlip_land + circlip_groove + 0.2) + spacer tube (27 to 40 mm)

params.name: x_half
params.comment: plate / housing inner half-width (x = -x_half back ... +x_half front), 50 to 70 mm

params.name: guard_r1
params.comment: belt guard inside radius round the 40T pulley (pitch radius + 6)

params.name: plate_top
params.comment: world y of the top edge: covers the belt guard's open face (derived)

params.name: tension_slot
params.comment: +- belt-tension travel of the module along the centre line (1 to 6 mm)

params.name: cover_r
params.comment: clutch cover outer radius (housing_od/2 + cover_wall)

params.name: tray_stack
params.comment: cover bottom at the lowest tension to the plate's bottom edge: 3 gap + 1 + PSU 30 + tray 1.5 + 0.5

params.name: plate_bot
params.comment: world y of the bottom edge (derived)

params.name: r_long
params.comment: housing outer radius of the long edges (8 to 16 mm)

params.name: panel_t
params.comment: housing wall thickness (2 to 4 mm)

params.name: corner_r
params.comment: bottom corner radius = the housing's inside radius (derived)

params.name: top_chamfer
params.comment: top corner chamfer legs, under the housing's chamfered inside + 0.3 (derived)

params.name: bearing_od
params.comment: 6002 OD = the straight-through stub bearing bore (H7)

params.name: circlip_land
params.comment: material outside each DIN 472-32 groove (2 to 4 mm)

params.name: circlip_groove
params.comment: DIN 472-32 groove width

params.name: circlip_groove_d
params.comment: DIN 472-32 groove diameter

params.name: clutch_bearing_od
params.comment: clutch output bearing OD (6001); its boss is this + 10 mm

params.name: boss_r
params.comment: half width of the clutch boss slot: the boss + 1 mm (derived)

params.name: cover_bolt_r
params.comment: radius of the clutch cover's 4 M5 module bolts (at 40, 140, 190, 350 deg in the clutch frame)

params.name: module_bolt_d
params.comment: M5 clearance width of the module bolt slots

params.name: standoff_x
params.comment: PLACEHOLDER x of the 4 standoffs either side of the leadscrew axis (where they land on the table end), 35 to x_half - 7 mm

params.name: standoff_y_hi
params.comment: PLACEHOLDER y of the upper standoff pair above the leadscrew axis (5 to plate_top - 14 mm)

params.name: standoff_y_lo
params.comment: PLACEHOLDER distance of the lower standoff pair below the leadscrew axis (clear of the module bolt heads)

params.name: standoff_cb
params.comment: counterbore depth for the M6 standoff screws' heads, from the outer face (6 to 10 mm)

params.name: enc_post_r
params.comment: radius of the 3 encoder post M3 taps, outside the bearing bore (18 to 30 mm)

params.name: tb_screw_x
params.comment: x of the tension block's 2 M5 taps, in the legs beside the slot

params.name: tb_y
params.comment: world y of the tension block centre and its M5 taps (derived)

params.name: tray_tab_x
params.comment: x of the mains tray's 2 floor tabs, either side of the slot (boss_r + 10 to x_half - 14 mm)

params.name: rebate_h
params.comment: tray tab rebate depth up from the bottom edge (tab 1.5 + 0.5 + 0.5)

params.name: rebate_hw
params.comment: half width of each tray tab rebate (tab half width 6 + 1)

params.name: rebate_depth
params.comment: tray tab rebate length in from the outer face (8 to plate_t - 6 mm)

params.name: rebate_r
params.comment: inner corner radius of the rebates (a 6 mm end mill from the bottom edge), less than rebate_hw

params.name: tray_screw_in
params.comment: M4 tray-tab tap: distance in from the outer face (less than rebate_depth - 2)

params.name: lap
params.comment: housing overlap on the plate edges; its M3 screws tap into the edges at lap/2 from the outer face
